acts.label: Prologue
acts.desc: In the middle of the night, host Ira Glass meets a woman on a mission at Port Authority bus station.

acts.label: Act One
acts.desc:
Producer Valerie Kipnis follows a group of people who’ve just arrived at their new home, a tent shelter in the middle of nowhere.
Reporting help from Jika Gonzalez.
acts.title: No Sleep ‘Till Brooklyn

acts.label: Act Two
acts.desc: Producer Diane Wu talks to an asylum seeker trying to hustle his way through bureaucratic limbo.
acts.title: 150 Days of Bummer

acts.label: Act Three
acts.desc: Host Ira Glass meets some of the city’s newest arrivals in every New Yorker’s least favorite place.
acts.title: Lullaby of Broadway

acts.label: Act Four
acts.desc: Three girls, whose families traveled thousands of miles to get to New York, navigate their latest challenge: American middle school.
acts.title: The New Kids

acts.label: Act 5
acts.desc: One woman needs to find shelter for 27 young men in a matter of hours.
acts.title: Harlem Shuffle (podcast only)
